concern_results.conclusion: Quiet now requires covered AND status exactly "passed": the merged covered flag preserves both commit and tree-equality coverage (moves_head forces covered=0, so HEAD-moving commands still remind), and covered findings/missing/unknown status fall into a distinct reminder naming receipt path, mode, status, and timestamp; missing-receipt and uncovered-HEAD messages also name the path. On the controller side, complete only joins anchors_wanted under the unchanged whole-worktree --base/no --paths gate, record_local_review runs solely on the success branch after result assembly, and the failed-completion test proves byte-identical receipts; the completion receipt is verified to bind the current HEAD, and a dirty-at-completion receipt would carry worktree_clean false, which the hook never treats as quiet. Passed+covered receipts (same commit or same tree) still exit 0, and the updated fixtures pin that with no new false reminders; no listed bypass reproduced.

Shared-gate containment holds: the hook stays non-blocking (only emits JSON via jq --arg, no execution of receipt content, malformed receipts degrade to silence as before), the controller change is two lines on an existing success path reusing the existing anchored receipt writer, and no verdict, budget, chain, or authorization logic is touched; both changed behaviors have killing mutations (status-predicate removal fails exactly the four status fixtures; reverting the completion write fails exactly the completion-success case), and the failure branch is proven byte-identical by cmp, so no unsafe state transition or false-green path is reachable.

challenge_focus: Try to make the reminder stay quiet while findings are outstanding, or make a completion checkpoint record a passed receipt for a HEAD or tree that no conclusive review covered: a complete run whose anchor HEAD differs from the reviewed candidate, a dirty worktree at completion, --paths or --diff-file combined with --base, a receipt from an older chain, a status value other than findings or passed, a HEAD-moving command in the same line. Also look for new false reminders on a genuinely passed and covered HEAD that would train agents to ignore it.
